25 feet long, weighing 5 tons, a jointed automaton that resembles a segmented worm with a dozen flippers. Functions on land or sea.

AC 15, HP 53, ATK 3 bite +9 (2d8 + swallow), MV near (swim), S +4, D +2, C +4, I -2, W +0, Ch -2, AL N, LV 11

Clockwork. Only damaged by adamantine or magical sources. Immune to damage from fire, cold, or non-magical sources. Double damage from electricity.

Steam Breath. 3/day, gout steam. Fills a near-sized cube extending from clockwork. DEX 15+ or 3d8 damage. Effective in water or on land.

Swallow. On a natural attack roll of 18-20, target is swallowed. Total darkness inside, 1d10 damage per round, and risk of drowning.
